test_scope: Input-only power status/history, GNSS reception, full bench records and USB readout; no hardware qualification

protocol.crc: CRC32/ISO-HDLC bytes0..1019, sequence bytes12..15 zeroed, CRC word255; only words127 and183 reserved zero. Power status153..159, USB160..182, GNSS184..254.

camera.power_after_enabled_query: ON; no automatic SD-card power cut
camera.mode_selection: Build option --camera-query, not a SWD memory-write command
camera.compatibility: Actual camera logic levels and timing unmeasured

imu.format: ACCEL_X/Y/Z, GYRO_X/Y/Z, TEMP, each signed int16; 2 zero pad bytes
imu.freshness: discard old status, wait new DRDY, single burst, reject DRDY/reset during read; does not certify internal sample coherence
imu.scope: Raw bench acquisition only; no orientation/control, FIFO/logging or accuracy certification

storage.format: M3LG v1: type3 full1024-byte CRC-valid snapshot in5 pages,3 samples/sector. Type2 historical512-byte prefix remains decodable.
storage.recovery: New boot appends after highest nonblank sector; CRC-valid complete records only; unknown/torn data retained

usb.identity_status: TinyUSB development example only; not an allocated production VID/PID

gnss.record: exact NAV-PVT92, MON-VER fixed40 + selected PROTVER30/MOD30; not complete wire transcript
gnss.queries: MON-VER and NAV-PVT empty read-only polls; no CFG/reset/control commands
gnss.scope: ordinary receiver diagnostics at roughly1Hz, not guidance/state estimation or RF qualification
gnss.dropped: lower bound: queued discarded bytes + ISR loss events

power_status.history: Low16 seen-low bit mask; high16 seen-high bit mask. No clear command. Fault falling-edge latches persist even if level recovered. ST edge direction is not reconstructed.
power_status.source_status: ST LOW=IN2 battery; HIGH=IN1 USB OR output high-Z, not uniquely determined. FLT high is not power-good.
power_status.timing: Nominal 1ms SysTick observations plus GPIO EXTI. HAL tick timestamps are not independent wall-clock measurements; masked/coalesced interrupts and pulses before init may be missed. IRQ count is a lower bound, not a pulse count.
power_status.commands: input-only; no fault clear, reset, power cycle or enable writes
